units.source_en: Just then, from the direction of Mount Tobinosu behind them came a sudden sound like muffled thunder—boom, boom, boom; boom, boom, boom… Gunfire erupted like an avalanche.

units.source_zh: 正在这时，突然从后方的鸢巢山方向传来闷雷似的声音，嗵嗵嗵，嗵嗵嗵……像雪崩一样，枪声大作。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正在这时，突然从后方的鸢巢山方向传来闷雷似的声音，嗵嗵嗵，嗵嗵嗵……像雪崩一样，枪声大作。

paragraphs.source_en: “Hah! Damn them!” Saburōbyōe reined in his warhorse and cursed. That volley did not sound as though it came from a mere fifty or sixty arquebuses. If a great enemy force had already stolen in behind them, their road of retreat had been cut off.

units.source_en: “Hah!
Damn them!”
units.source_zh: 畜生！”

units.source_en: Saburōbyōe reined in his warhorse and cursed.
units.source_zh: 三郎兵卫勒住战马，骂了一声。

units.source_en: That volley did not sound as though it came from a mere fifty or sixty arquebuses.
units.source_zh: 这枪声听起来不像是只有五六十支的样子。

units.source_en: If a great enemy force had already stolen in behind them, their road of retreat had been cut off.
units.source_zh: 如果大敌已经摸到了背后，那么后路便被掐断了。

paragraphs.source_zh: “嗬！畜生！”三郎兵卫勒住战马，骂了一声。这枪声听起来不像是只有五六十支的样子。如果大敌已经摸到了背后，那么后路便被掐断了。

paragraphs.source_en: There could be no doubt: the shots had been fired by the arquebus raiding force led by Sakai Saemon-no-jō Tadatsugu. Leading the five hundred arquebusiers whom Nobunaga had specially assigned to him, Tadatsugu had stolen onto Mount Tobinosu the previous night. The sudden, earth-shaking gunfire threw the camps of Takeda Sama-no-suke on the left and Obata Kazusa-no-suke, held in reserve behind them, into seething confusion.

units.source_en: There could be no doubt: the shots had been fired by the arquebus raiding force led by Sakai Saemon-no-jō Tadatsugu.
units.source_zh: 毋庸置疑，这枪声正是酒井左卫门尉忠次率领的火枪奇袭队打响的。

units.source_en: Leading the five hundred arquebusiers whom Nobunaga had specially assigned to him, Tadatsugu had stolen onto Mount Tobinosu the previous night.
units.source_zh: 忠次率领信长特意配给他的五百火枪手，昨天晚上就已摸到了鸢巢山上。

units.source_en: The sudden, earth-shaking gunfire threw the camps of Takeda Sama-no-suke on the left and Obata Kazusa-no-suke, held in reserve behind them, into seething confusion.
units.source_zh: 突如其来的震天枪声，使左邻的武田左马助和在后面待机的小幡上总介的阵营像炸了锅一样，乱作一团。

paragraphs.source_zh: 毋庸置疑，这枪声正是酒井左卫门尉忠次率领的火枪奇袭队打响的。忠次率领信长特意配给他的五百火枪手，昨天晚上就已摸到了鸢巢山上。突如其来的震天枪声，使左邻的武田左马助和在后面待机的小幡上总介的阵营像炸了锅一样，乱作一团。

paragraphs.source_en: Yamagata Saburōbyōe held his reins and stood as motionless as a statue. After a long moment, he shouted, “All of you, take heed!” Then he spurred his horse toward the palisade like the wind.

units.source_en: Yamagata Saburōbyōe held his reins and stood as motionless as a statue.
units.source_zh: 山县三郎兵卫勒住马缰，像塑像一样立在那里，一动不动。

units.source_en: After a long moment, he shouted, “All of you, take heed!”
units.source_zh: 良久，他大喊一声：“各位注意！”

units.source_en: Then he spurred his horse toward the palisade like the wind.
units.source_zh: 接着像风一样催马跑到栅栏前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 山县三郎兵卫勒住马缰，像塑像一样立在那里，一动不动。良久，他大喊一声：“各位注意！”接着像风一样催马跑到栅栏前。

paragraphs.source_en: The great battle began. No—it would be truer to say that two thousand mounted warriors became a raging gale, intent on trampling Ōkubo’s infantry into the earth.

units.source_en: The great battle began.
units.source_zh: 大战开始。

units.source_en: No—it would be truer to say that two thousand mounted warriors became a raging gale, intent on trampling Ōkubo’s infantry into the earth.
units.source_zh: 不，不如说是两千名骑兵武士为了踏平大久保的步兵，卷起了一阵狂风。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大战开始。不，不如说是两千名骑兵武士为了踏平大久保的步兵，卷起了一阵狂风。

paragraphs.source_en: Dawn slowly broke as war drums thundered and conch horns sounded their long call.

units.source_en: Dawn slowly broke as war drums thundered and conch horns sounded their long call.
units.source_zh: 天渐渐地亮了，战鼓咚咚，号角长鸣。
